name: tplqueue-core-public
description: Public TplQueue.Core consumption workflows for the factory facade, queue lifecycle, observation, retry behavior, CacheQ semantics, and DataJob/Payload usage without exposing private implementation details.

interface.shortDescription: Public Core factory, queue, observer, retry, and payload guidance.
interface.longDescription: Seven portable, instruction-only skills providing public consumer guidance for the privately implemented TplQueue.Core execution kernel. Covers public surface review, factory construction, queue lifecycle, observation, retry selection, CacheQ semantics, and DataJob/Payload usage. Complements Engineering, Abstractions, Adapter, and Usage workflows. Current public contracts, maintained public documentation, and observable behavior remain authoritative. The plugin and its instructions are MIT; Core package and source licenses remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Review my use of the public TplQueue.Core API.
Explain Core queue completion and CacheQ acknowledgment.
Check root and queue retry-policy precedence.
